title: Vibecoding a game made me appreciate games again.
author: loongo
selftext:
Been messing around with a game for my friends and I and am having a blast revisiting what makes games so satisfying, and becoming very appreciative for these tools that are making it possible.

What I mean by that are all little things I never thought of, like how the camera reacts to the players movements.  
Or how UI elements have to dynamically format themselves to suit the users device.  
Things that make the flow of the experience satisfying.  
It's like a game to MAKE the dang game.

While I wish we had these tools at our disposal in our youth, I am so excited for these next generations to figure them out to their full potential.

ALSO if anyone has any criticisms or ideas for the project, it can be found at:  
[www.dungeonsofdunbar.com](http://www.dungeonsofdunbar.com)

I'm currently testing space flight and would love some feedback, I could talk about this stuff for hours!

Hope you're all having a good one.
